name: Shikaku Tantei Sora no Sekai ~Thousand Dreams~
original_name: 死角探偵　空の世界　～Thousand Dreams～
source:
Shikaku Tantei - Sora no Sekai - Thousand Dreams is an adventure game in which player takes the role of a detective who has to investigate assassination (or suicide) in the mansion with the help of three sisters living there.

[Edited from [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/psx2/games2/SLPM-66803.html]Psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
《死角侦探：空之世界～Thousand Dreams～》是一款冒险游戏。玩家将扮演侦探，在居住于宅邸的三姐妹协助下，调查那里发生的杀人事件——也可能是自杀事件。

[据[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/psx2/games2/SLPM-66803.html]PSX DataCenter[/url]内容编辑]
